version: hidden-rubric-v2 (2026-10-25 cleanup: measurements moved into checks.py)

scoring.zh: 每条判定二元（0/1），部分满足即0。reward = Σ(权重×通过)/Σ(权重)，权重为0的条目（M04）只作信息、不计分。M04 撤权后其权重按比例分给 mid 层其余16条（各 17/16），各层权重占比不变。除 B09、G11、G14 的画面部分由评委看联系表判定外，其余全部由 checks.py 机测（ffprobe/ffmpeg、numpy 音频分析、Blender 后台逐帧导出）。按 events.csv 声明帧测量；片中第 f 帧对应场景第 frame_start+f 帧。
scoring.en: Binary criteria; partial = 0. reward = Σ(weight×pass)/Σ(weight); weight-0 items (M04) are informational and never scored. M04's weight is redistributed proportionally over the other 16 mid items (17/16 each) so tier shares are unchanged. Everything except the visual parts of B09, G11 and G14 (judged from the contact sheets) is measured by checks.py (ffprobe/ffmpeg, numpy audio analysis, headless Blender per-frame export). Measurements anchor on declared events.csv frames; film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f.

group_gates.zh: scene.blend 缺失或无法在 Blender 4.3 后台打开 → project、camera、contact、sim 组全部记0（导出超时/脚本错误不触发本门槛，相关条目各自记失败并写明原因）。
group_gates.en: scene.blend missing or cannot be opened headless -> groups project, camera, contact, sim = 0 (a dump timeout/script error does not trigger this gate; the affected items fail individually with the reason).

group_gates.zh: M14 重渲 SSIM 实测 <0.75 → contact 组记0（重渲失败/超时只使 M14 失败，不触发本门槛）。
group_gates.en: M14 measured re-render SSIM < 0.75 -> group contact = 0 (a render failure/timeout fails M14 only).

group_gates.zh: G11 失败（机测部分不合格，或评委判定为平面着色/卡通/白模）→ look、sim 组其余条目记0。
group_gates.en: G11 fails (measured part, or the judge sees a flat/cartoon/clay look) -> the other look and sim items = 0.

group_gates.zh: events.csv 缺失或无法解析 → 所有按声明帧测量的条目（M03、M05、M09、M16、M17、G01、G02、G04–G07、G13）记0。
group_gates.en: events.csv missing/unparseable -> all declared-frame criteria (M03, M05, M09, M16, M17, G01, G02, G04-G07, G13) = 0.

criteria.criterion_zh: 基础版成片编码契约：恰好900帧；H.264、yuv420p、1280×720、方形像素、恒定30fps；AAC立体声48kHz且音频覆盖整段画面。
criteria.criterion_en: Base film contract: exactly 900 frames; H.264, yuv420p, 1280x720, square pixels, CFR 30; AAC stereo 48 kHz covering the picture.
criteria.verify: ffprobe -count_frames；检查 codec/pix_fmt/size/SAR/r_frame_rate=avg_frame_rate=30/1；音频时长≥画面时长-1帧。

criteria.criterion_zh: 修订版成片编码契约：恰好891帧，其余规格同 B01。
criteria.criterion_en: Revision film contract: exactly 891 frames, otherwise as B01.

criteria.criterion_zh: 两版母带：综合响度 −18±2 LUFS；解码采样峰值 ≤ −1 dBFS；无削波样本。
criteria.criterion_en: Both masters: −18±2 LUFS integrated; decoded sample peak ≤ −1 dBFS; no clipped samples.
criteria.verify: ffmpeg ebur128 / astats；削波=连续≥3样本|x|≥0.999。

criteria.criterion_zh: 分轨格式：两版均有 stems/speech、kitchen、hall 三条，48kHz PCM，时长分别为30.0 s与29.7 s（±1帧）。
criteria.criterion_en: Stem format: speech/kitchen/hall in both versions, 48 kHz PCM, 30.0 s and 29.7 s (±1 frame).
criteria.verify: soundfile.info 逐条核对。

criteria.criterion_zh: events.csv 表头恰为 event_id,frame,description；14个必需 id 全部存在且各出现一次；帧号为0–899的整数。
criteria.criterion_en: events.csv header exact; all 14 required ids present once; integer frames in 0–899.
criteria.verify: csv 解析。

criteria.criterion_zh: 两版 timeline.json 均可解析，且包含：shot/clip/range 键下的镜头范围，其数值含各镜头起点（基础版 180/390/540/720，修订版 180/381/531/711）和终点（900/899 或 891/890），帧或秒均可；4个转场（"transitions" 列表/字典含4项，或 T12/T23/T34/T45 四个 id）；speech、kitchen、hall 各有数值型 in/out（start/end/region/offset）；以及母带增益（与分轨名同处、键名含 "gain" 的数值）。
criteria.criterion_en: timeline.json in both versions parses and contains: shot ranges under a shot/clip/range key whose numbers include the shot starts (base 180/390/540/720, revision 180/381/531/711) and the end (900/899 or 891/890), as frames or seconds; 4 transitions (a "transitions" list/dict with 4 entries, or ids T12/T23/T34/T45); numeric in/out (start/end/region/offset) values for each of speech, kitchen, hall; and master gains (numeric key containing "gain" next to each stem name).
criteria.verify: checks.py：json 解析后遍历键路径与数值做上述匹配（键名不限于示例，按子串识别）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 工程可用：scene.blend 在 Blender 4.3 后台可打开；README 含一条同时出现 `blender` 与 `-b`/`--background`（顺序不限）的导出命令行；MEI/LIN（网格）、MEI_RIG/LIN_RIG（骨架）、POT/POT_LID/LADLE/BOWL/DOOR/STOVE、至少1个 SOUP_DOMAIN* 与 STEAM_DOMAIN* 对象、CAM_S1–CAM_S5（摄影机）全部存在且类型正确；场景自定义属性 revision_trim_frames 存在。
criteria.criterion_en: Project usable: scene.blend opens headless in Blender 4.3; README contains an export command line with `blender` and `-b`/`--background` (any order); MEI/LIN (mesh), MEI_RIG/LIN_RIG (armature), POT/POT_LID/LADLE/BOWL/DOOR/STOVE, at least one SOUP_DOMAIN* and STEAM_DOMAIN* object and CAM_S1–CAM_S5 (camera) exist with correct types; scene custom property revision_trim_frames exists.
criteria.verify: blender -b -y scene.blend --python（_cdc_blend.rich_dump）导出对象表；README 逐行正则。打不开 → GG1；导出超时/脚本错误 → 本条失败（写明原因），不触发 GG1。

criteria.criterion_zh: credits.md 存在，写明 Blender 并说明台词制作方式（如 espeak-ng/sox/TTS/合成/录制人声）；qa.md 存在且非空；交付中所有文本文件无凭据、无指向网络媒体的 URL。
criteria.criterion_en: credits.md exists, names Blender and states how the lines were produced (e.g. espeak-ng/sox/TTS/synthesised/recorded voice); qa.md exists and is non-empty; no credentials and no URL media references in any text file of the delivery.
criteria.verify: checks.py：文件存在性 + 关键词正则 + 凭据/URL 媒体正则扫描。

criteria.criterion_zh: 无字幕、字卡、叠加图形或配乐：（机测）两版 kitchen、hall 分轨中不存在这样的 3 s 窗：≥80% 的 100 ms 帧为调性帧（80–4000 Hz 最强谱峰比其 ±1/3 倍频程内频点中位数高 ≥15 dB）且有 ≥3 个主导音级各占 ≥10% 帧（旋律/和声；稳定嗡声、哨声或带限噪声不算）；（画面，评委）两版成片联系表中无字幕、片名/说明字卡或叠加图形（场景道具上的文字不计）。
criteria.criterion_en: No subtitles, cards, graphic overlays or music: (measured) neither the kitchen nor the hall stem of either version contains a 3 s window in which ≥80% of 100 ms frames are tonal (the strongest 80–4000 Hz spectral peak is ≥15 dB above the median of the bins within ±1/3 octave) with ≥3 dominant pitch classes each present in ≥10% of the frames (melody/harmony; a steady hum, whistle or band-limited noise does not count); (visual, judge) the contact sheets of both films show no subtitles, title/explanatory cards or graphic overlays (text on scene props does not count).
criteria.verify: checks.py 先做音乐检测，不合格直接判否；合格时交评委看联系表判画面叠加。

criteria.criterion_zh: 剪辑结构：恰好4处剪切，分别位于第180、390、540、720帧（±1帧），均为无混合帧的硬切；无其他剪切；剪辑点附近无叠化；无定格（解码后连续≥6帧除编码舍入外完全相同，即全分辨率亮度无像素变化超过2级；固定机位镜头须有可见运动或渲染噪声）。
criteria.criterion_en: Edit structure: exactly 4 cuts at frames 180/390/540/720 (±1), all hard with no blend frames; no other cuts; no dissolve near the edit points; no freeze (≥6 consecutive decoded frames identical up to codec rounding, i.e. no full-resolution luma pixel changes by more than 2 levels; a locked-off shot needs visible motion or render noise).
criteria.verify: 320×180 灰度逐帧差+直方图距离检测硬切；切点两侧混合帧检验；预期切点 ±6 帧内查持续中等差分（叠化）；全分辨率逐帧流式比较查定格（容差2级）。

criteria.criterion_zh: J-cut 精度：hall 分轨起音（首个高于 −50 dBFS 的 10 ms 窗）在 12.00±0.05 s，11.95 s 前低于 −60 dBFS。
criteria.criterion_en: J-cut accuracy: hall stem onset (first 10 ms window above −50 dBFS) at 12.00±0.05 s and below −60 dBFS before 11.95 s.
criteria.verify: hall.wav 10 ms RMS 包络定起音；起音前段 10 ms 窗最大电平。

criteria.criterion_zh: 画外起句：声明的 line_door_start 在第360–389帧（剪辑前、门厅声音进入后），实测起点与声明相差≤6帧；line_door_end 落在 S3（390–539）。
criteria.criterion_en: Off-screen line start: declared line_door_start in 360–389, measured within ±6 frames; line_door_end inside S3.
criteria.verify: speech.wav VAD（webrtcvad 模式2）分句，与 events.csv 对照。

criteria.criterion_zh: （信息项，权重0——评分镜像中无 ASR 模型。）台词可懂：离线 whisper small.en 对 speech 分轨逐句识别，文本归一化（小写、去标点、展开缩写）后，三句合并 WER ≤0.20（12词中≤2词错），且每句≤1词错。
criteria.criterion_en: (Informational, weight 0 — no ASR model in the verifier image.) Intelligibility: offline whisper small.en per line on the speech stem; after normalisation (lowercase, no punctuation, contractions expanded) pooled WER over the three lines ≤0.20 (≤2 of 12 words) and ≤1 word error per line.
criteria.verify: 不评分；不交评委（weight 0 → na）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 台词与声明一致：line_warn 与 line_thanks 实测起止与声明相差≤6帧，line_warn 全部落在 S4、line_thanks 全部落在 S5。
criteria.criterion_en: Lines match declarations: line_warn/line_thanks measured within ±6 frames of declared, inside S4 and S5 respectively.
criteria.verify: 同 M03。

criteria.criterion_zh: 两个声音可区分且不单调、语速合规：每句（取与声明窗口重叠的能量 VAD 段）自相关基频（70–400 Hz）浊音帧标准差≥1.5半音；梅一句与林两句的中位基频相差≥2半音；每句语速2.0–4.5词/秒（词数按 transcript.en.txt 书写计：3、3、4；句长=VAD 首个起点到末个终点）。
criteria.criterion_en: Two distinct, non-monotone voices at the stated rate: per line (segment = energy-VAD speech overlapping the declared window), autocorrelation F0 (70–400 Hz) has a voiced-frame SD ≥1.5 semitones; median F0 of Mei's line and of Lin's lines differ by ≥2 semitones; 2.0–4.5 words/s per line (words as written in transcript.en.txt: 3, 3, 4; duration = first VAD onset to last offset).
criteria.verify: checks.py：numpy 自相关 F0（40 ms 帧/10 ms 步长，归一化峰>0.5 为浊音）+ 能量 VAD。

criteria.criterion_zh: 口型同步：S3（第390–539帧）中 LIN、S4（第540–719帧）中 MEI，各自至少一条口部通道（其骨架上 jaw/chin/mouth/lip 姿态骨的旋转角或位移，或其网格上 jaw/mouth/viseme 形态键）与 speech 分轨 30 fps RMS 包络在 ±2帧（≤80 ms）滞后内相关系数 r≥0.4。
criteria.criterion_en: Lip-sync: in S3 (frames 390–539) for LIN and in S4 (540–719) for MEI, at least one mouth channel of that character (rotation angle or translation of a jaw/chin/mouth/lip pose bone of its rig, or a jaw/mouth/viseme shape key on its meshes) correlates with the 30 fps RMS envelope of the speech stem with r ≥0.4 at a lag within ±2 frames (≤80 ms).
criteria.verify: rich_dump 逐帧导出口部骨骼 matrix_basis 旋转角/位移与形态键值；checks.py 求各滞后皮尔逊相关取最大。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）

criteria.criterion_zh: 镜头参数（从工程逐帧导出，宽松阈值）：S1 平视（CAM_S1 平均高度1.1–1.9 m、俯仰±10°内）、位移<1 cm、焦距不变、景深关闭或 f≥5.6；S2 全程俯仰≤−30°（下俯）、位移<1 cm、景深开启且 f≤4；S3 平视（同 S1）、焦距不变、手持抖动（相对15帧滑动平均的最大偏离）位置1–60 mm 或视向≥0.1°（位置抖动仍须≤60 mm）；S4 LIN 评估后网格包围盒投影到 CAM_S4 占画面5–45%（镜头内中位数）且中心位于画面左或右40%区域，相机到 MEI_RIG 距离在镜头内缩短≥0.08 m，焦距不变，景深开启；S5 位置变化<2 cm、俯仰角单调上抬（容差0.05°）≥3°、景深开启。五镜头须全部满足。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Camera grammar from project data (lenient): S1 eye level (CAM_S1 mean height 1.1–1.9 m, pitch within ±10°), displacement <1 cm, constant focal length, DOF off or f≥5.6; S2 pitch ≤ −30° (looking down) throughout, displacement <1 cm, DOF on with f≤4; S3 eye level (as S1), constant focal length, handheld jitter (max deviation from the 15-frame moving average) of position 1–60 mm or of view direction ≥0.1° (position jitter still ≤60 mm); S4 LIN's evaluated mesh bbox projected into CAM_S4 covers 5–45% of the frame (median over the shot) with its centre in the left or right 40% of the frame, camera distance to MEI_RIG decreases by ≥0.08 m over the shot, constant focal length, DOF on; S5 position change <2 cm, pitch rising monotonically (≤0.05° noise) by ≥3°, DOF on. All five shots must pass. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 逐帧导出 CAM_S* matrix_world、lens、传感器、shift、dof/fstop，LIN 评估包围盒；投影公式与 bpy_extras.world_to_camera_view 一致。

criteria.criterion_zh: 关门同步：DOOR 旋转在声明 door_close ±2帧内停止，hall 分轨在该处±2帧有关门瞬态（峰值高于前500 ms 底噪≥12 dB）。
criteria.criterion_en: Door sync: DOOR rotation stops within ±2 frames of declared door_close and hall stem has a transient there (≥12 dB over prior 500 ms).
criteria.verify: 工程导出 DOOR 角速度；hall.wav 瞬态检测。

criteria.criterion_zh: 厨房声学连续：kitchen 分轨在13.0、18.0、24.0 s（修订版12.7、17.7、23.7 s）三处均无断口（跨点±500 ms 内无 >20 ms 低于 −70 dBFS 的段）；同室的24.0 s（23.7 s）处底噪电平跳变<3 dB；跨房间的13.0、18.0 s（12.7、17.7 s）处允许视角衰减/恢复，底噪电平跳变≤20 dB。底噪电平=跨点前/后各500 ms 内 20 ms RMS 的第10百分位。
criteria.criterion_en: Kitchen continuity: no gap at 13/18/24 s (rev 12.7/17.7/23.7 s) (no >20 ms below −70 dBFS within ±500 ms); floor step <3 dB at the same-room cut 24.0 s (23.7 s); perspective change allowed at the room-change cuts 13.0/18.0 s (12.7/17.7 s), floor step ≤20 dB. Floor = 10th percentile of 20 ms RMS over 500 ms each side.
criteria.verify: kitchen.wav 20 ms RMS 第10百分位跨点比较 + 静音段检测。

criteria.criterion_zh: 分轨一致：两版 stems 与解码混音对齐后在 ≤4 kHz 低通带内最小二乘残差 ≤ −25 dB（相对同带混音 RMS）；timeline.json 中声明的母带增益（键名含 db 按 dB，否则线性或 dB 取相符者）与拟合增益相差≤1 dB。找不到声明增益判否。
criteria.criterion_en: Stems sum to mix in both versions: after alignment, residual in the ≤4 kHz low-passed band ≤ −25 dB rel. mix RMS in that band; declared master gains (located in timeline.json; dB if the key says db, else linear or dB, whichever matches) within 1 dB of the fitted gains. Gains that cannot be located fail.
criteria.verify: 解码 AAC 后互相关对齐、4 kHz 低通、最小二乘拟合增益（AAC 192k 宽带残差约 −16 dB、4 kHz 以下约 −32 dB，故只比低频带）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 修订画面传播：修订版第0–380帧与基础版同帧 PSNR≥30 dB；修订版第381–890帧与基础版第390–899帧 PSNR≥30 dB；修订版剪辑点为381、531、711帧（±1）。
criteria.criterion_en: Revision picture: rev 0–380 equals base (PSNR ≥30); rev 381–890 equals base 390–899; cuts at 381/531/711 (±1).
criteria.verify: 逐帧 PSNR（下采样到 640×360）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 修订声音传播与同源：修订版 hall 起音 11.70±0.05 s 且 11.65 s 前低于 −60 dBFS；11.65 s 前混音与基础版一致（≤4 kHz 带内残差≤ −25 dB）；11.7 s 之后 speech 相对基础版整体提前0.300±0.010 s；评分方以 revision_trim_frames=9 从同一 .blend 重渲修订版第400帧（480×270、8 spp；求解者渲染器无输出时改用 Cycles），与修订成片 480×270 SSIM≥0.75。重渲失败/超时判否。
criteria.criterion_en: Revision audio and same-source: rev hall onset 11.70±0.05 s and below −60 dBFS before 11.65 s; mix before 11.65 s unchanged (≤4 kHz residual ≤ −25 dB); speech after 11.7 s shifted −0.300±0.010 s; a grader re-render of revision frame 400 from the same .blend with revision_trim_frames=9 (480×270, 8 spp; Cycles fallback if the solver engine writes no image) has SSIM ≥0.75 against the revision film at 480×270. A failed/timed-out re-render fails this item.
criteria.verify: 互相关求偏移；blender -b -y 设置属性后渲染单帧。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）

criteria.criterion_zh: 工程即真实来源：评分方从 scene.blend 重渲基础版第90、270、465、630、810帧（480×270、8 spp；无绑定相机的标记时依次用 CAM_S1–S5；求解者渲染器无输出时改用 Cycles），与成片 480×270 SSIM 均≥0.75。渲染失败/超时判否（不触发 GG2）。
criteria.criterion_en: Project is the source of truth: grader re-renders base frames 90/270/465/630/810 from scene.blend (480×270, 8 spp, CAM_S1–S5 if no camera-bound markers; Cycles fallback if the solver engine writes no image); each has SSIM ≥0.75 against the film at 480×270. A failed/timed-out render fails this item (without triggering GG2).
criteria.verify: blender -b -y 低采样重渲 + SSIM。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）

criteria.criterion_zh: 人物绑定：MEI/LIN 网格各由对应骨架驱动（骨架修改器或骨架父级）；每个骨架两只手各有≥4条手指链、每链≥3根带关键帧的骨（按 thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky+左右侧名称分组，或手骨下的骨链），且每只手至少2根手指的关键帧曲线不同（独立动画）；每个角色有带关键帧的 jaw/chin/mouth/lip 骨或有动画的 jaw/mouth/viseme 形态键；两人网格为立体（世界包围盒三轴均≥0.1 m）。
criteria.criterion_en: Rigs: MEI and LIN meshes are each deformed by their armature (armature modifier or armature parent); on each rig both hands have ≥4 finger chains with ≥3 keyed bones each (finger bones grouped by name thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky + side, or chains under a hand bone), and on each hand at least 2 fingers have different keyframe curves (individually animated); each character has a keyed jaw/chin/mouth/lip bone or an animated jaw/mouth/viseme shape key; both meshes are volumetric (world bbox ≥0.1 m in every axis).
criteria.verify: rich_dump：armature 修改器/父子关系、骨表、动作 fcurve（含 NLA）、形态键动作、评估包围盒。

criteria.criterion_zh: 掀盖声音语义：kitchen 分轨在声明 lid_lift ±3帧内有锅盖接触/离锅瞬态；lid_lift 后1 s 内沸腾声（1–6 kHz 带）比前1 s 升高≥3 dB。
criteria.criterion_en: Lid-lift sound semantics: lid transient within ±3 frames of declared lid_lift; boiling band (1–6 kHz) ≥3 dB louder in the 1 s after than the 1 s before.
criteria.verify: kitchen.wav 带通能量 + 瞬态检测。

criteria.criterion_zh: 事件声明合理：lid_grip<lid_lift<180；ladle_in<pour_start<pour_end 均在180–389；door_close 在390–539；line_warn 在540–719；lin_touch<mei_release，mei_release 在720–899；line_thanks 在720–899；同一句起<止。
criteria.criterion_en: Event declarations plausible: ordering and shot membership as listed.
criteria.verify: 纯 csv 逻辑检查；与实测无关。

criteria.criterion_zh: 握盖接触：声明 lid_grip 帧 MEI 任一手/手指骨（骨段 head–tail）到 POT_LID 把手（锅盖顶部中心 3 cm 内的表面采样点）距离≤1.5 cm；lid_grip 之前 POT_LID 原点移动<2 mm；lid_grip 之后直到锅盖离开 CAM_S2 画框（或第389帧），每帧手到把手距离≤2 cm。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Lid grip contact: at declared lid_grip a MEI hand/finger bone (segment head–tail) is ≤1.5 cm from the POT_LID knob (lid surface samples within 3 cm of the top centre); POT_LID origin moves <2 mm before lid_grip; from lid_grip until the lid leaves the CAM_S2 frame (or frame 389) the hand–knob distance stays ≤2 cm in every frame. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 逐帧导出 MEI_RIG 手部骨世界坐标与 POT_LID 变换、表面采样；checks.py 求骨段到点集最近距离；CAM_S2 投影判出画。

criteria.criterion_zh: 离锅与热气因果：POT_LID 最低表面点与 POT 最高表面点的间隙相对第0帧首次增加>5 mm 的帧落在声明 lid_lift ±2帧内；第175–185帧锅盖逐帧上升（z 增加）；STEAM_DOMAIN* 气体密度总和（Blender 读取烘焙缓存）在 lid_lift 后15帧内的峰值≥其前15帧均值的3倍。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Lift and steam causality: the gap between the lowest POT_LID surface sample and the highest POT surface sample first exceeds its frame-0 value by >5 mm within ±2 frames of declared lid_lift; POT_LID rises (z increasing) through every frame 175–185; total STEAM_DOMAIN* gas density (baked cache, read in Blender) peaks within 15 frames after lid_lift at ≥3× its mean over the 15 frames before. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump：表面采样+逐帧变换；Fluid domain_settings.density_grid 求和。

criteria.criterion_zh: T12 动作匹配：剪辑前（178→179）与剪辑后（180→181）POT_LID 速度方向夹角≤45°、速率比0.5–2；179→180 额外位置跳变（扣除两速度均值）<3 cm；锅盖中心在 CAM_S1（178→179）与 CAM_S2（180→181）投影中均向画面上方运动；第180帧锅盖至少部分位于 CAM_S2 画框内。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: T12 match on action: POT_LID velocity before (178→179) and after (180→181) the cut differ by ≤45° in direction with speed ratio 0.5–2; extra position jump at 179→180 (beyond the mean of the two velocities) <3 cm; the lid centre moves screen-up in CAM_S1 (178→179) and in CAM_S2 (180→181); the lid is at least partly inside the CAM_S2 frame at 180. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 变换 + 相机投影。

criteria.criterion_zh: 舀汤接触：声明 ladle_in 到 pour_end 每帧 MEI 右手骨（未区分左右时取任一手骨）到 LADLE 表面≤2 cm；声明 ladle_in 帧勺头中心位于液体内（SOUP_DOMAIN* 评估网格之并）；ladle_in 到 pour_start 之间≥50%采样帧勺头（LADLE 长轴较宽一端的球域）内液体≥1 mL。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Ladling contact: from declared ladle_in to pour_end a MEI right-hand bone (any MEI hand bone if sides are not named) is ≤2 cm from the LADLE surface in every frame; at declared ladle_in the ladle head centre is inside the liquid (union of evaluated SOUP_DOMAIN* meshes); between ladle_in and pour_start the ladle head (sphere at the wider end of LADLE's long axis) contains ≥1 mL of liquid in ≥50% of sampled frames. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump extra：逐帧评估 SOUP_DOMAIN* 网格建 BVH，最近点法向判内外，网格采样估体积。

criteria.criterion_zh: 倒汤：声明 pour_start 到 pour_end 之间≥70%帧液体连接勺头与碗（勺头→碗沿中心线段 20–80% 处各点在液体内或距液面≤1.5 cm）；BOWL 内（BOWL 局部包围盒内切圆柱，网格采样）液体体积从不比其累计最大值低5%以上且5 mL 以上，pour_end 时≥30 mL 且≥pour_start 时勺头液体体积的50%。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Pour: between declared pour_start and pour_end, in ≥70% of frames the liquid connects ladle head and bowl (every point at 20–80% along the head→bowl-rim-centre segment lies inside or ≤1.5 cm from the liquid surface); liquid volume inside BOWL (inner cylinder of BOWL's local bbox, grid-sampled) never drops more than 5% and 5 mL below its running maximum, and at pour_end is ≥30 mL and ≥50% of the ladle-head volume at pour_start. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: 同 G04（逐帧 BVH 采样）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 碗始终有支撑：声明 pour_end 到第899帧每一帧 BOWL 与 MEI 或 LIN 至少一根手/手指骨距离≤2 cm，或 BOWL 最低点正下方表面≤5 mm（场景射线检测）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Bowl always supported: from declared pour_end to frame 899, in every frame BOWL is ≤2 cm from at least one MEI or LIN hand/finger bone, or the surface directly below BOWL's lowest point is ≤5 mm away (scene ray cast). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump：骨段到 BOWL 表面采样距离；extra 中 scene.ray_cast。

criteria.criterion_zh: 交接重叠：实测 lin_touch（LIN 手/手指骨首次距 BOWL 表面≤1.5 cm）与 mei_release（MEI 手/手指骨最后一次≤1.5 cm）分别与声明值相差≤3帧；两人同时≤1.5 cm 的帧≥4；实测 mei_release 落在 S5（720–899）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Handover overlap: measured lin_touch (first frame a LIN hand/finger bone is ≤1.5 cm from the BOWL surface) and mei_release (last frame a MEI hand/finger bone is ≤1.5 cm) are each within ±3 frames of declared; both within 1.5 cm simultaneously ≥4 frames; measured mei_release inside S5 (720–899). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: 同 G06 的逐帧距离表。

criteria.criterion_zh: T45 动作匹配与轴线：BOWL 在 719→720 的额外跳变（扣除 718→719 与 720→721 速度均值）<3 cm，剪辑处速度≥1 cm/s；CAM_S4@719 与 CAM_S5@720 投影中 MEI 手部与 LIN 手部（各骨架手骨均值）横坐标差的符号相同（不越轴）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: T45 match on action and axis: BOWL extra jump at 719→720 (beyond the mean of the 718→719 and 720→721 velocities) <3 cm and BOWL speed across the cut ≥1 cm/s; the sign of u(MEI hands) − u(LIN hands) (projected mean of each rig's hand bones) is the same in CAM_S4@719 and CAM_S5@720 (no axis jump). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 变换 + 骨骼 + 投影。

criteria.criterion_zh: 热气模拟：有 STEAM_DOMAIN* 对象为 Mantaflow 气体域，其缓存目录位于 project/ 内且含覆盖 S2 与 S5 ≥80% 帧的文件；采样帧（Blender 读取）密度场在 S2、S5 每个采样帧非零，4×4×4 粗分布在相邻采样间变化（≥80% 的相邻对；非静止/冻结场），密度加权竖直速度向上（中位数>0）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Steam sim: a STEAM_DOMAIN* object is a Mantaflow GAS domain whose cache directory lies inside project/ and holds files for ≥80% of the S2 and S5 frames; the density grid (read in Blender at sampled frames) is non-zero in every sampled S2 and S5 frame, its 4×4×4 coarse distribution changes between consecutive samples (≥80% of pairs; not a static or frozen field), and the density-weighted vertical velocity is upward (median >0) in S2 and S5. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump：domain_settings（cache_directory、density_grid、velocity_grid、domain_resolution）；缓存文件名中的帧号覆盖率。

criteria.criterion_zh: 汤液模拟：有 SOUP_DOMAIN* 对象为 Mantaflow 液体域，其缓存目录位于 project/ 内且含覆盖 S2 ≥80% 帧的文件；液体几何（SOUP_DOMAIN* 评估网格）在≥90%的 S2 采样帧存在且顶点数在 S2 内有变化（模拟液面，非刚体道具）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Soup sim: a SOUP_DOMAIN* object is a Mantaflow LIQUID domain whose cache directory lies inside project/ and holds files for ≥80% of the S2 frames; liquid geometry (evaluated SOUP_DOMAIN* meshes) is present in ≥90% of sampled S2 frames and its vertex count changes over S2 (a simulated surface, not a rigid prop). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump：fluid 设置 + 缓存文件 + 逐帧评估网格。

criteria.criterion_zh: 写实渲染：（机测）主体对象 MEI、LIN、POT、POT_LID、BOWL、LADLE、STOVE 使用基于节点的 BSDF 材质，其中≥3个有纹理或 BSDF 输入接有节点（表面变化）；至少一个柔光（面光、灯光尺寸/半径>2 cm、日光角>0.3°）或环境/天空世界光；Cycles 渲染开启降噪；5个镜头中至少3个平涂块指数≤0.35（平涂块=方差<1.0且与上下左右4块均值差均<0.5的8×8亮度块，排除均值<24或>235的块；每15帧抽样、每镜头取中位数）；（画面，评委）联系表呈现写实材质、光照与阴影，无平面着色/卡通/未贴图白模外观。（组级门槛 GG3。）
criteria.criterion_en: Photoreal render: (measured) the hero objects MEI, LIN, POT, POT_LID, BOWL, LADLE, STOVE use node-based BSDF materials, ≥3 of them with a texture or a linked BSDF input (surface variation); at least one soft light (area light, light size/radius >2 cm, sun angle >0.3°) or an environment/sky world; Cycles renders denoised; flat-block index ≤0.35 in at least 3 of 5 shots (flat block = 8×8 luma block with variance <1.0 whose mean differs <0.5 from all 4 neighbours, excluding blocks with mean <24 or >235; per-shot median over frames sampled every 15); (visual, judge) the contact sheets show photoreal materials, lighting and shadows — no flat-shaded, cartoon or untextured clay look. (Group gate GG3.)
criteria.verify: checks.py 先测材质/灯光/降噪/平涂块指数，任一不合格直接判否；全部合格时交评委看联系表。

criteria.criterion_zh: 手指包裹：声明 lid_grip 帧（POT_LID 把手，MEI）、ladle_in–pour_end 中点（LADLE，MEI 右手）、lin_touch–mei_release 中点（BOWL，MEI 与 LIN 各自）一只手至少3根不同手指（按名称与左右侧分组的手指骨）有骨段距所握物体≤2 cm。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Finger wrap: at declared lid_grip (POT_LID knob, MEI), at the middle of ladle_in–pour_end (LADLE, MEI right hand), and at the middle of lin_touch–mei_release (BOWL, for MEI and for LIN) at least 3 distinct fingers of one hand (finger bones grouped by name and side) have a bone within 2 cm of the held object. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 骨段 + 物体表面采样距离。

criteria.criterion_zh: 碗中汤随碗运动：声明 pour_end 到片尾每个采样帧碗内液体≥pour_end 时体积的50%，且其质心与碗轴水平距离≤3 cm；声明 lin_touch 到 mei_release 之间至少一帧碗内液面（7×7 网格向下射线命中点）高差≥2 mm（非刚性液面）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Soup moves with the bowl: from declared pour_end to the end, in every sampled frame the liquid inside BOWL stays ≥50% of its pour_end volume and its centroid is within 3 cm (horizontally) of the bowl axis; between declared lin_touch and mei_release the liquid surface inside the bowl (downward ray hits on a 7×7 grid) has a height range ≥2 mm in at least one frame (non-rigid surface). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: 同 G04（逐帧 BVH 采样与射线）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 叙事可读（画面）：仅凭联系表即可读出“奶奶在厨房盛汤—孙子穿冬衣从门口进来—热汤从她手中递到他手里”；画面无解释性文字。（先闻其声、房间声学与无音乐由 M02、M03、M10、B09 机测。）
criteria.criterion_en: Narrative readability (visual): from the contact sheets alone the sequence reads as grandmother serving soup in the kitchen → grandson arriving at the doorway in winter clothing → the hot bowl handed from her hands to his; no on-screen text explains the story. (Sound order, room acoustics and absence of music are measured in M02, M03, M10 and B09.)
criteria.verify: 评委看两版成片联系表（视觉判断）。

judge_items: B09 (visual part, after the measured music test passes)
G11 (visual part, after the measured parts pass)
